reviews.review_description: I've used Mixed Reality putting in Golf+ since August when it was in beta.  My main motivation has been to improve my real life putting. Golf+ immersive putting has been particularly helpful for my lag putting technique and face control. I especially like that I can tweak the speed of the greens to match those at my home course. I can't yet claim that Golf+ Putting helps me read real-life greens any better, but I now have a much better appreciation of the importance of the 'fall line' concept.  I use this app every day to take part in the daily and weekly competitions (including the warm-up section).  Competition against others is highly motivating and so I rarely use the other modes. This gives me 20-25 minutes of putting practice each day, which can only be a good thing for my long-term putting improvement.  I putt on a blue interlocking EVA foam mat using a Lab DF-3 style (knock off!) putter and I have never had any problems with tracking. Improvements?  I would love to see random tee positions and more pin positions.  Currently it is possible to 'practice' a round multiple times, learning all the lines to take, thus giving some players an artificial advantage over those (like me) who eschew the practice round.  Real life golf never gives you the opportunity to putt from the same place twice, so neither should Golf+ Putting.  As a putting practice aid, it cannot be beaten as an overall package and the monthly subscription is worth it (even though I already own a lot of the Golf+ courses).  Putt Dojo uses similar technology on fictional (as opposed to PGA) greens but for now, the competitions are what keep me coming back to Golf+.

developer_response.body: Hi Gazonymous, Thanks so much for taking the time to share this feedback and I can't tell you what it means to the team to hear we are having a positive impact on your real-life game! We can’t thank you enough for being with us since the beta and being apart of the foundation of GOLF+ Putting. We've noted your suggestions! We’re going to keep building it for a long time to come, and we’re excited to have you along for the ride!

reviews.review_description:
I’ve been using GOLF+ Immersive Putting since the beta first dropped, and it’s become a regular part of my putting practice.

Using your actual putter and golf ball makes the experience feel incredibly natural. You can even adjust the stimp to match the green speeds you’re used to playing in real life, which is a great feature for making practice more relevant to your game.

One of my favorite aspects is how the app gamifies practice. Playing the different putting courses adds variety and keeps things interesting without feeling like you’re just repeating the same drills over and over.

More importantly, I’ve seen the results carry over to the actual golf course. My distance and speed control have improved noticeably, and I’m three-putting less frequently as a result. That’s really the biggest endorsement I can give it.

The development team also deserves credit for being receptive to community feedback and consistently improving the experience. I’ve been following the progress since beta, and it’s been great seeing the app continue to evolve.

Whether you’re an experienced golfer looking to improve your putting or someone just getting into the game, I think this is a worthwhile addition to your practice routine. It’s an enjoyable way to get more reps in, and in my experience, those reps translate to better putting on the course.

Looking forward to seeing how the team continues to develop it.

Another fantastic add to a game that I have played just about daily since its release in 2021. I can't express how invested you feel with every putt, especially when on courses with crowds. All you need is about 5 feet of space in front of you, a putter, a white golf ball on a contrasting color surface and you're good to go. Beyond immersive and super fun. Additional green speeds have been added so you can choose in increments of .5 to help dial in the speed of your local course and use the many practice tools to stay sharp and improve year round. There is a daily and weekly in-game TOUR (you choose your green speed), or you can play solo on 9 different putt routings for every course in the game.

Really impressed with how polished this feels already. The transition from hitting the ball to seeing it roll in-game is pretty much instant, which makes the whole experience feel really natural. Super smooth and honestly a lot more immersive than I expected.
Personally as a real golfer it is a great game but after the tutorial it makes you pay 50$ a year i think or a month
